clues.it: Tea era nella 3ª colonna, accanto a uno scaffale e a nord di Nino.
clues.en: Tea was in the 3rd column, beside a shelf and north of Nino.

clues.it: Sergio era nella 2ª riga, a ovest di Anna e in Plancia.
clues.en: Sergio was in the 2nd row, west of Anna and on the Bridge.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Irene era nella 2ª colonna, nella 4ª riga e a ovest di Anna.
clues.en: Irene was in the 2nd column, in the 4th row and west of Anna.

clues.it: Luca era accanto a una rete e nella stessa stanza di Irene.
clues.en: Luca was beside a net and in the same room as Irene.

clues.it: Bruno era nella 6ª riga e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Bruno was in the 6th row and west of Vito.

clues.it: Marta era nella 5ª colonna, nella 7ª riga e in Stiva.
clues.en: Marta was in the 5th column, in the 7th row and in the Hold.

clues.it: Elena era a nord di Anna e da sola in Cabina.
clues.en: Elena was north of Anna and alone in the Cabin.

clues.it: Nino era nella 9ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Vito.
clues.en: Nino was in the 9th row and in a different room from Vito.

clues.it: Ugo era in una stanza diversa da Irene.
clues.en: Ugo was in a different room from Irene.

clues.it: Dario era nella 1ª colonna e nella 11ª riga, ma non era accanto a una cassa.
clues.en: Dario was in the 1st column and in the 11th row, but was not beside a crate.

clues.it: Anna era nella 7ª colonna, nella 12ª riga e a ovest di Nino.
clues.en: Anna was in the 7th column, in the 12th row and west of Nino.

general_clues.en: 6 in the west half of the grid.
6 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Tea lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 3ª.
steps.en: Tea's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 3rd.

steps.it: Solo Sergio può stare nella 2ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 4ª è sua.
steps.en: Sergio is the only one who can be in the 2nd row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 4th is theirs.
